title: 3D solver reference of a case
description: meta.yaml next to reference.sNp in cases/<id>/references/<solver>/. The last entry of levels is the solve that produced reference.sNp. Figures derived across solvers are computed by emref, not stored.

label.description: What sets this level: mesh pass, grid resolution, boundary distance.

max_ds_to_previous.description: max |dS| to the previous level over all entries and the band. Absent on the first level only.

version.description: Release or commit of the solver.

ports.description: The port list of case.yaml realised: reference_ports where the case has them, else ports.

model.description: Model settings, a free mapping: conductor model, boundary type, box distances, element order or grid resolution, frequency sweep kind.

levels.description: Refinement series (adaptive mesh or grid), coarse to fine.

box_series.description: Optional series over the distance of the boundary to the structure, near to far.

converged_bound.description: The bound on max_ds_to_previous of the last level of each series. A reference above it is kept with its number and shown as not converged.

runtime_s.description: Wall-clock time of the last level.

memory_peak_gb.description: Peak memory of the last level.
